dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the lateral margins observed from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior edge of the visible frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized asymmetrical indentation present on the left lateral margin in the mid-body region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity blue-grey shading on the lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the depigmented central dorsal axis and the shaded lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal indentation or structural fold running along the right-central dorsal axis.
